purpose: Canonical target-input progressive H3 topology and defaults. Mixed-Grid is retained only as a deprecated compatibility path.

placement.trajectory_capture: internal to H3ProgressiveTargetInputHandoff; no separate H3TrajectoryCapture node is required

canonical_defaults.weight_semantics: With guidance_mode=direction+temporal, acceleration_weight and consistency_weight are staged values only; apply_guidance does not use them unless the corresponding guidance mode is selected.

unprotected_progressive_contract.handoff_probe: one exact low-grid H3 probe at the selected boundary
unprotected_progressive_contract.video_transfer: learned_3d by default; bicubic remains a compatibility/control option
unprotected_progressive_contract.history: fresh sampler and Spectrum lifetime across the geometry boundary

exact_prefix_contract.trigger: any exact-zero prepared video denoise-mask value

audio_guided_overlap.scope: tail of a canonical carried audio prefix during sampler lifetime only

exact_prefix_contract.caller_owned_output: original exact video/audio mask semantics remain authoritative at the sampler return boundary

deprecated_compatibility.reason_for_preserving_id: existing serialized workflows must keep their original semantics rather than silently changing to Target Input

invariants.continuum_grid: final target grid for the whole external session
